name: Mesh Texture Optimization via SDS
definition: Optimizes the vertex texture map of a fixed 3D mesh geometry to match a text prompt using Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) gradients, without modifying the mesh vertices or faces.
summary: Mesh Texture Optimization via SDS optimizes vertex colors on a fixed 3D mesh using SDS gradients, differing from NeRF by optimizing explicit colors rather than implicit fields.
